# google_dialogflow_companion_agent

A Companion Agent in Dialogflow.


To get more information about CompanionAgent, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/dialogflow/es/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.companionAgents)
* How-to Guides
    * [Official Documentation](https://cloud.google.com/agent-assist/docs)

## Example Usage - Dialogflow Companion Agent Basic


```hcl
resource "google_dialogflow_companion_agent" "default" {
  location           = "global"
  companion_agent_id = "companion-agent"
  display_name       = "companion-agent-basic"
  description        = "Basic Companion Agent Description"

  skill_configs {
    skill_triggering_event = "END_OF_UTTERANCE"
    guidance_skill_config {
      overarching_guidance = "Initial guidance"
      guidance_instructions {
        display_name            = "greeting"
        display_details         = "Greeting for the customer"
        condition               = "Customer starts conversation"
        disable_suggested_reply = true
        trigger_event           = "CUSTOMER_MESSAGE"
        actions {
          description = "Greet customer warmly"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Example Usage - Dialogflow Companion Agent Tools


```hcl
resource "google_ces_app" "app" {
  location     = "us"
  app_id       = "ces-app"
  display_name = "ces-app"

  time_zone_settings {
    time_zone = "America/Los_Angeles"
  }
}

resource "google_ces_tool" "tool_1" {
  location       = "us"
  app            = google_ces_app.app.name
  tool_id        = "ces-tool-1"
  execution_type = "SYNCHRONOUS"

  python_function {
    name        = "lookup_order"
    python_code = "def lookup_order(order_id: str) -> str: return order_id"
  }
}

resource "google_ces_toolset" "toolset_1" {
  location       = "us"
  app            = google_ces_app.app.name
  toolset_id     = "ces-toolset-1"
  display_name   = "ces-toolset-1"
  execution_type = "SYNCHRONOUS"

  open_api_toolset {
    open_api_schema = <<-EOT
      openapi: 3.0.0
      info:
        title: Order API
        version: 1.0.0
      servers:
        - url: https://api.example.com/v1
      paths:
        /orders:
          get:
            operationId: getOrder
            parameters:
              - name: order_id
                in: query
                required: true
                schema:
                  type: string
            responses:
              '200':
                description: OK
    EOT
  }
}

resource "google_dialogflow_companion_agent" "default" {
  location           = "us"
  companion_agent_id = "companion-tools"
  display_name       = "companion-tools"
  description        = "Companion Agent with CES tools"

  ces_tool_specs {
    ces_tool                 = google_ces_tool.tool_1.id
    confirmation_requirement = "NOT_REQUIRED"
    proactive_enabled        = true
    reactive_enabled         = false
    parameter_overrides {
      parameter_name        = "order_id"
      context_reference_key = "order_context"
      field_path            = "order.id"
    }
  }

  toolset_tools {
    toolset                  = google_ces_toolset.toolset_1.id
    operation_id             = "getOrder"
    confirmation_requirement = "NOT_REQUIRED"
    proactive_enabled        = false
    reactive_enabled         = true
    parameter_overrides {
      parameter_name        = "order_id"
      context_reference_key = "order_context"
      field_path            = "order.id"
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the companion agent.

* `companion_agent_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID to use for the companion agent, which will become the final component of the companion agent's resource name.


* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  Display name for the companion agent.

* `description` -
  (Optional)
  Description for the companion agent.

* `skill_configs` -
  (Optional)
  List of skill configs for the companion agent.
  At most one skill config of each type (for example, at most one `guidance_skill_config`) may be configured.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_skill_configs).

* `ces_tool_specs` -
  (Optional)
  List of CES tool specs that the companion agent can choose from.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_ces_tool_specs).

* `toolset_tools` -
  (Optional)
  List of CES toolset specs that the companion agent can choose from.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_toolset_tools).

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_skill_configs"></a>The `skill_configs` block supports:

* `skill_triggering_event` -
  (Optional)
  The event that should trigger the skill.
  Possible values are: `END_OF_UTTERANCE`, `CUSTOMER_MESSAGE`, `AGENT_MESSAGE`.

* `guidance_skill_config` -
  (Optional)
  Guidance skill configuration.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_skill_configs_guidance_skill_config).


<a name="nested_skill_configs_guidance_skill_config"></a>The `guidance_skill_config` block supports:

* `overarching_guidance` -
  (Optional)
  This is specific additional guidance that can be configured by the user.

* `guidance_instructions` -
  (Optional)
  Customized instructions for guidance.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_skill_configs_guidance_skill_config_guidance_instructions).


<a name="nested_skill_configs_guidance_skill_config_guidance_instructions"></a>The `guidance_instructions` block supports:

* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  Display name for the instruction.

* `display_details` -
  (Optional)
  The detailed description of this instruction.

* `condition` -
  (Optional)
  The condition of the instruction.

* `disable_suggested_reply` -
  (Optional)
  Whether to disable suggested reply generation for this instruction.

* `trigger_event` -
  (Optional)
  Event that triggers the guidance instruction.
  Possible values are: `END_OF_UTTERANCE`, `CUSTOMER_MESSAGE`, `AGENT_MESSAGE`.

* `actions` -
  (Optional)
  The action items that can be processed.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_skill_configs_guidance_skill_config_guidance_instructions_actions).


<a name="nested_skill_configs_guidance_skill_config_guidance_instructions_actions"></a>The `actions` block supports:

* `description` -
  (Required)
  Description of action item.

<a name="nested_ces_tool_specs"></a>The `ces_tool_specs` block supports:

* `ces_tool` -
  (Optional)
  The resource name of the CES tool.
  Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/tools/{tool}`.

* `confirmation_requirement` -
  (Optional)
  Indicates whether the tool requires human confirmation.
  Possible values are: `REQUIRED`, `NOT_REQUIRED`.

* `proactive_enabled` -
  (Optional)
  Indicates whether the tool is enabled in proactive mode.
  All tools are enabled in proactive mode by default. To disable a tool in proactive mode, set this field to `false`.
  NOTE: At least one of `proactive_enabled` or `reactive_enabled` should be `true` else the tool will be ignored.

* `reactive_enabled` -
  (Optional)
  Indicates whether the tool is enabled in reactive mode.
  All tools are disabled in reactive mode by default. To enable a tool in reactive mode, set this field to `true`.
  NOTE: At least one of `reactive_enabled` or `proactive_enabled` should be `true` else the tool will be ignored. CompanionAgent config will throw an error if any unsupported tool is enabled in reactive mode.

* `parameter_overrides` -
  (Optional)
  Overrides for the tool's input parameters. When the tool is called, each listed parameter is set to the value found in the ingested context references, populating it if omitted by the model or replacing any value predicted by the model. Duplicate entries for the same `parameter_name` are disallowed and rejected during Companion Agent validation.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_ces_tool_specs_parameter_overrides).


<a name="nested_ces_tool_specs_parameter_overrides"></a>The `parameter_overrides` block supports:

* `parameter_name` -
  (Required)
  The name of the tool input parameter to override, as defined in the tool's input schema. For example, `user_email`.

* `context_reference_key` -
  (Required)
  The key of the context reference in ingested context references.

* `field_path` -
  (Optional)
  The path into the JSON object of the latest content ingested under `context_reference_key` (e.g. `email` or `user.email`). If omitted, the entire content under `context_reference_key` is used.
  If the path cannot be resolved when the tool is called, the value predicted by the model is used (or omitted if the model did not predict it).

<a name="nested_toolset_tools"></a>The `toolset_tools` block supports:

* `toolset` -
  (Required)
  The name of the toolset to retrieve the schema for.
  Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/toolsets/{toolset}`.

* `operation_id` -
  (Optional)
  The `operationId` field of the OpenAPI endpoint. The `operationId` must be present in the toolset's definition.

* `confirmation_requirement` -
  (Optional)
  Indicates whether the tool requires human confirmation.
  Possible values are: `REQUIRED`, `NOT_REQUIRED`.

* `proactive_enabled` -
  (Optional)
  Indicates whether the toolset tool is enabled in proactive mode.
  NOTE: At least one of `proactive_enabled` or `reactive_enabled` should be `true` else the toolset tool will be ignored.

* `reactive_enabled` -
  (Optional)
  Indicates whether the toolset tool is enabled in reactive mode.
  NOTE: At least one of `reactive_enabled` or `proactive_enabled` should be `true` else the toolset tool will be ignored.

* `parameter_overrides` -
  (Optional)
  Overrides for the tool's input parameters. When the tool is called, each listed parameter is set to the value found in the ingested context references, populating it if omitted by the model or replacing any value predicted by the model. Duplicate entries for the same `parameter_name` are disallowed and rejected during Companion Agent validation.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_toolset_tools_parameter_overrides).


<a name="nested_toolset_tools_parameter_overrides"></a>The `parameter_overrides` block supports:

* `parameter_name` -
  (Required)
  The name of the tool input parameter to override, as defined in the tool's input schema. For example, `user_email`.

* `context_reference_key` -
  (Required)
  The key of the context reference in ingested context references.

* `field_path` -
  (Optional)
  The path into the JSON object of the latest content ingested under `context_reference_key` (e.g. `email` or `user.email`). If omitted, the entire content under `context_reference_key` is used.
  If the path cannot be resolved when the tool is called, the value predicted by the model is used (or omitted if the model did not predict it).

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/companionAgents/{{companion_agent_id}}`

* `name` -
  The unique identifier of the companion agent.
  Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/companionAgents/{companion_agent}`.

* `create_time` -
  Creation time of this companion agent.

* `update_time` -
  Update time of this companion agent.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


CompanionAgent can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/companionAgents/{{companion_agent_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{companion_agent_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{companion_agent_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import CompanionAgent using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    companionAgentId = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_dialogflow_companion_agent.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import CompanionAgent using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/companionAgents/{{companion_agent_id}}"
  to = google_dialogflow_companion_agent.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), CompanionAgent can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_dialogflow_companion_agent.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/companionAgents/{{companion_agent_id}}
$ terraform import google_dialogflow_companion_agent.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{companion_agent_id}}
$ terraform import google_dialogflow_companion_agent.default {{location}}/{{companion_agent_id}}
```
